scene: The opened brass music box projects glowing transit tickets into the air.
picture: A flat side view along the tent boards. On the far left, a bright bicycle rickshaw waits by an exit. Left of centre, the tall Latino man watches the open brass music box. In the centre, an open metal book cart lift rests. On the far right, a glowing night bus idles beside the flap.
shown: a wheeled bicycle rickshaw with canopy waiting parked on the far left
a motorized book cart lift with lever waiting on the centre floor
a purring night bus idling through an open tent flap far right
